me.title: Hi, I'm Hamza
body: Computer Science senior at the American University of Sharjah, graduating Spring 2027.
I like engineering that solves real problems: defense and safety systems, tech that helps people walk or see again, and systems that spot emergencies and get help faster.
Looking for software, AI, robotics and defense-tech roles and internships.

items.name: Quantum Security Challenge — CSAW'26 QSec
items.summary: Solved all 4 quantum security challenges as a 3-person team at NYU Abu Dhabi. Built white- and black-box adversarial attacks on quantum road-sign classifiers and defenses that raised robust accuracy from 0.63 to 0.76.

items.name: Confidence-Guided Multimodal Waste Sorting Conveyor
items.summary: Recyclable-waste sorting conveyor scaling from 3 to 11 classes by fusing camera vision with spectral, infrared and inductive sensors on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, with servo actuators and confidence-aware decisions.

items.name: Software Development Intern — GAES
items.summary: Built an offline exam generator and question-bank manager in Python/Flask for an EASA Part-147 aviation training organisation, then presented it to company leadership.

items.name: Undergraduate Research Assistant — AUS
items.summary: Blockchain-based trust layer for IoT devices (Sui + oneM2M). Primary applicant on an undergraduate research grant proposal and co-author of a literature review on autonomous waste-sorting robots.

items.name: GPS-free autonomous drone
items.summary: Coming soon. A 3D-printed drone that navigates without GPS.

items.name: Night vision goggles / Wi-Fi through-wall sensing

about.title: About me
body: What drives me: engineering for a better life. Defense and safety systems, assistive tech that helps people walk or see, and sensors that detect emergencies and call for help.
Into: fighter jets and aerospace (the Su-57 and Su-47 on my wall), drones, robotics, computer vision and 3D printing.
Off the desk: gaming, films and the gym.
Languages: Arabic (native, with a deep Arabic literature background) and English (fluent).
